title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
statement: A sorted array of distinct values was rotated at an unknown pivot. Return its minimum element in logarithmic time.
hints: The minimum is the single point where the array stops increasing.
Compare nums[mid] against nums[hi], not nums[lo]. That comparison is unambiguous.
If nums[mid] > nums[hi] the minimum is strictly right of mid, so lo = mid + 1. Otherwise mid could itself be the minimum, so hi = mid.
